name: kiosk
description: Office wall screen for a Raspberry Pi: clock, weather and news.

scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:scripts && npm run test:installer && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:server: cd server && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.test:installer: python3 -m unittest discover -s installer/tests -p 'test_core.py' && xvfb-run -a python3 -m unittest discover -s installer/tests -p 'test_app.py'
